rules.title: Diabetes diagnosis required for CGM coverage
rules.summary: Therapeutic CGMs and related supplies are covered by Medicare when all of the following coverage criteria (1-6) are met: 1. The beneficiary has diabetes mellitus (Refer to the ICD-10 code list in the LCD-related Policy Article for applicable diagnoses); and,
rules.source_sentence: The beneficiary has diabetes mellitus (Refer to the ICD-10 code list in the LCD-related Policy Article for applicable diagnoses); and,

rules.title: Frequent BGM testing required for CGM coverage
rules.summary: Therapeutic CGMs and related supplies are covered by Medicare when all of the following coverage criteria (1-6) are met: 2. The beneficiary has been using a BGM and performing frequent (four or more times a day) testing; and,
rules.source_sentence: The beneficiary has been using a BGM and performing frequent (four or more times a day) testing; and,

rules.title: Insulin-treated with multiple daily injections or Medicare-covered CSII pump required for CGM coverage
rules.summary: Therapeutic CGMs and related supplies are covered by Medicare when all of the following coverage criteria (1-6) are met: 3. The beneficiary is insulin-treated with multiple (three or more) daily injections of insulin or a Medicare-covered continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion (CSII) pump; and,
rules.source_sentence: The beneficiary is insulin-treated with multiple (three or more) daily injections of insulin or a Medicare-covered continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion (CSII) pump; and,

rules.title: Insulin regimen requires frequent adjustment for CGM coverage
rules.summary: Therapeutic CGMs and related supplies are covered by Medicare when all of the following coverage criteria (1-6) are met: 4. The beneficiary's insulin treatment regimen requires frequent adjustment by the beneficiary on the basis of BGM or CGM testing results; and,
rules.source_sentence: The beneficiary's insulin treatment regimen requires frequent adjustment by the beneficiary on the basis of BGM or CGM testing results; and,

rules.title: In-person visit within 6 months prior to ordering CGM required
rules.summary: Therapeutic CGMs and related supplies are covered by Medicare when all of the following coverage criteria (1-6) are met: 5. Within six (6) months prior to ordering the CGM, the treating practitioner has an in-person visit with the beneficiary to evaluate their diabetes control and determined that criteria (1-4) above are met; and,
rules.source_sentence: Within six (6) months prior to ordering the CGM, the treating practitioner has an in-person visit with the beneficiary to evaluate their diabetes control and determined that criteria (1-4) above are met; and,

rules.title: Follow-up in-person visit every 6 months required for continued CGM coverage
rules.summary: Therapeutic CGMs and related supplies are covered by Medicare when all of the following coverage criteria (1-6) are met: 6. Every six (6) months following the initial prescription of the CGM, the treating practitioner has an in-person visit with the beneficiary to assess adherence to their CGM regimen and diabetes treatment plan.
rules.source_sentence: Every six (6) months following the initial prescription of the CGM, the treating practitioner has an in-person visit with the beneficiary to assess adherence to their CGM regimen and diabetes treatment plan.

rules.title: Only one unit of K0553 may be billed per 30 days
rules.summary: The supply allowance (code K0553) is billed as 1 Unit of Service (UOS) per thirty (30) days. Only one (1) UOS of code K0553 may be billed to the DME MACs at a time. Billing more than 1 UOS per 30 days of code K0553 will be denied as not reasonable and necessary.
rules.source_sentence: Billing more than 1 UOS per 30 days of code K0553 will be denied as not reasonable and necessary.

rules.title: BGM and related supplies not covered when CGM is approved
rules.summary: Claims for a BGM and related supplies, billed in addition to an approved CGM device (code K0554) and associated supply allowance (code K0553), will be denied.
rules.source_sentence: Claims for a BGM and related supplies, billed in addition to an approved CGM device (code K0554) and associated supply allowance (code K0553), will be denied.
